def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    # Four markers are ordered upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right by position.
    top=sorted([p for p in pts if p[0] < h//2], key=lambda p:p[1])
    bot=sorted([p for p in pts if p[0] >= h//2], key=lambda p:p[1])
    if len(top)!=2 or len(bot)!=2: return out
    ul,ur=top; ll,lr=bot
    colors=[grid[ll[0]][ll[1]],grid[ul[0]][ul[1]],grid[lr[0]][lr[1]],grid[ur[0]][ur[1]]]
    for (r,c),(dr,dc),color in zip([ul,ur,ll,lr],[(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)],colors):
        y,x=r,c
        while 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w:
            out[y][x]=color
            y+=dr; x+=dc
    return out
PY
